scenarios.title: Changes screen
steps: Build the demo with scripts/make-docs-demo.sh and start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Wait until its status is on screen and leave the window as it opens.
On screen: Changes on the left, the empty editor area, the Files panel on the right, the status bar.

scenarios.title: Side-by-side diff of src/cart.ts
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Click src/cart.ts under Changes: its diff opens in the Diff tab, Collapse unchanged on (the default).
note: 0.1.0-beta.7 never folds side-by-side diffs (fixed as GM-40, not released yet),
so against it this scenario scores about 81% (light) and 75% (dark).
Against a build with the fix it scored 99.04% (light) and 98.28% (dark) on 2026-10-08.
In dark mode beta.7 paints some fills and text one step differently while the display has HDR headroom
(any HDR content on screen), so gm-measure captures with HDR off (--hdr off, the default).

scenarios.title: Side-by-side diff of src/cart.ts, every line
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and click src/cart.ts under Changes.
Turn off Collapse unchanged in the diff toolbar: every line shows, the first change centered.
note: With HDR off, beta.7 in dark mode puts the right pane in its own layer once the merge view scrolls
and paints its #1e1f22 as 30, 31, 33 (followed in GM-50).

scenarios.title: Changes after staging src/cart.ts
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Point at src/cart.ts under Changes and click its Stage button (+): it moves to the Staged group.

scenarios.title: Welcome screen (no folder)
steps: Start the app with an empty home folder and no folder: the Projects page with Open and Clone.
Open demo/acme/storefront, then File > Close Folder: the project is in the recent list.

scenarios.title: Workspace with several repositories
steps: Start the app on demo/acme: storefront, payments-api (stopped in a merge) and the plain folder notes.
Changes lists both repositories; open the folder menu in the header.

scenarios.title: Files panel right-click menu
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Right-click src/cart.ts in the Files panel and point at Add to .gitignore.

scenarios.title: File icons: Material Icons
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Choose View > File Icons > Material Icons and open the src folder in the Files panel.

scenarios.title: Rounded panels
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Open Settings (Cmd+,), Appearance, turn on Rounded panels and close Settings.

scenarios.title: A file open in the editor
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Double-click src/cart.ts in the Files panel: a tab with the code and the change markers in the gutter.
Put the cursor on line 10.

scenarios.title: src/catalog.ts in a file tab
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Double-click src/catalog.ts in the Files panel: it opens in a kept tab.
The tab shows the path bar, the code and the cursor line's blame note (the file has no changes).

scenarios.title: Tab strip: pinned and wrapped tabs
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Double-click src/cart.ts, src/checkout.ts, README.md, package.json and docs/checkout.md.
Right-click the README.md tab, choose Pin Tab, and turn on Settings > Editor > Wrap tabs.

scenarios.title: Single tab mode
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and set Settings > Editor > Tab limit to Single tab.
Double-click src/cart.ts: its name shows centered in the strip.

scenarios.title: Split editor
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and double-click src/cart.ts.
Choose Window > Split Right, open README.md there, then choose Window > Split Down.

scenarios.title: New File
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Press Cmd+N (File > New File) and type a line: the Untitled tab takes its name and shows a dot.

scenarios.title: Markdown editor with preview
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Double-click docs/checkout.md: the text, the toolbar and the live preview side by side.

scenarios.title: Image preview
steps: Start the app on demo/acme.
Click notes/logo.png in the Files panel: the image opens in a preview tab.

scenarios.title: Search Everywhere
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and open src/cart.ts at line 10, column 11.
Edit > Select Next Occurrence selects lines; Edit > Find in Files opens the Text tab with it.
Close the src/cart.ts tab (the popup stays): 8 matches in 1 file over the Changes screen.

scenarios.title: Quick Open with recently opened files
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront; open src/pricing.ts, README.md and src/cart.ts, then close them.
Press Cmd+P (Edit > Go to File...): Recently opened lists cart.ts, README.md and pricing.ts.

scenarios.title: Command Palette
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Press Shift+Cmd+P (View > Command Palette...): every command, enabled ones first, A to Z.

scenarios.title: Recent Files
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront, open src/cart.ts, then docs/checkout.md.
Press Cmd+E (Edit > Recent Files...).

scenarios.title: Navigation Bar
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and double-click src/cart.ts.
Press Cmd+Up (Edit > Jump to Navigation Bar): the list of src opens with cart.ts selected.

scenarios.title: Find and replace bar
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and double-click src/cart.ts.
Press Cmd+R (Edit > Replace...) and type total.

scenarios.title: Sign-in prompt
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Add a remote whose HTTP server answers 401 (as the askpass-sign-in shot of scripts/screenshots.ts does).
Fetch: the Sign in dialog asks for a username and a password.

scenarios.title: Commit options
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Click the gear next to Commit in the commit box, then the arrow next to Commit.
